content.title: 2021 ESC Guidelines on cardiac pacing and cardiac resynchronization therapy - Reviewers
content.note: Report lists declarations of interest as reported to the ESC by the experts during the yearly call for declaration covering the previous calendar year (calls conducted up to and including 2020).

experts.name: Linde Cecilia
experts.declaration_summary: Research funding (personal) from healthcare industry; involvement with pharmaceutical company AstraZeneca related to heart failure biomarkers and proteomics/lipidomics; additional funding from public/charitable bodies for devices and heart failure and heart failure epidemiology.
details: AstraZeneca: heart failure biomarkers, proteomics lipidomics
Stockholm County Council: devices and heart failure (research funding)
Swedish Heart Lung Foundation: devices and heart failure (research funding)
Swedish Research Council: heart failure epidemiology (research funding)

experts.name: Linker Nicholas John
experts.declaration_summary: Other positions of influence - membership/affiliation in political, advocacy or patient organisations in cardiology; Trustee and Medical Director role.
details: Trustee and Medical Director of the Arrhythmia Alliance

experts.name: Mairesse Georges H
experts.declaration_summary: Financial declarations: direct personal payments from healthcare industry for speaker fees, honoraria, consultancy, advisory board fees, investigator and committee member roles; relationships with multiple companies across anticoagulant, cholesterol and pacemaker areas.
